note: Proposed fresh-agent behavior evals, not executed by the deterministic CLI tests. Use temporary repository fixtures, no live tracker/forge writes, and capture conversation plus file changes. Compare old and new instructions on the same model. Each case starts before setup and continues with the stated owner answers.

evals.name: discovery-led-customization
evals.prompt: Set up review preferences for this repository. Find out what is here first, then help me choose what to customize.
evals.fixture: A repository with schema migrations, an HTTP client, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/storage.md, CI tests, and existing setup policies documenting local Markdown tickets, completion after operator acceptance, and serial reviewers. No review profile. Owner initially answers: the findings are accurate; customize for migration compatibility and retries. Then supplies any missing rule details. Withhold draft confirmation until it is explicitly requested.
evals.expected_output: Cites discovered files before asking questions, asks whether to customize, tailors questions to migration compatibility and retry behavior, reuses local-ticket/serial setup, and presents a proposed profile/reference diff for confirmation before any policy write.
assertions: Discovery distinguishes documented policies from inferred risks and unknowns before customization questions.
Questions validate findings and offer keeping defaults, customization or deferral with a recommendation.
Follow-up questions address the owner's named risks and missing rules rather than prescribing a database, tracker or harness.
Draft extends applicable defaults with repository references and records applicability, source, evidence and blocking thresholds for new rules.
Existing lifecycle and execution policies are reused; configuration does not change tracker states or launch helpers.
No profile or reference policy is written before owner confirmation.

evals.name: keep-existing-customizations
evals.prompt: Refresh review setup for this repo. I want to keep my current choices, not do a customization interview again.
evals.fixture: An existing valid profile with an accessibility category, a replaced integration checklist, and setup-owned hosted-tracker automation. All reference files exist and contain owner edits.
evals.expected_output: Negative control: inspects current configuration and validates findings without repeating the already answered customization choice, preserves owner content and override modes, and does not replace the profile with the bundled template.
assertions: Reuses the owner's keep-current answer instead of asking the customization choice or a generic priorities interview again.
Preserves custom categories, reference contents, override modes and automation ownership.
Runs the read-only resolver and distinguishes valid file selection from validated policy semantics.
Any proposed correction is shown for confirmation before writing.

evals.name: defer-or-unattended
evals.prompt: Inspect this repo and propose review setup, but do not change policy files. I cannot answer questions right now.
evals.fixture: A repository with no profile, no ticket-policy output, a test command and partial conventions documentation. Run without a dedicated question tool or helper capability.
evals.expected_output: Uses ordinary conversation to present discovered facts and unanswered choices, leaves policy files untouched, and explains that reviews remain usable with defaults without claiming configuration complete.
assertions: No question tool, helper, ticket provider or prerequisite setup is required to inspect and propose.
Does not invent missing lifecycle policy or treat silence as confirmation.
Repository profile and policy files remain unchanged.
Reports pending owner choices and available defaults rather than completed configuration.
